title_en: The Name That Is Itself the Supreme Reality

sentences.mr: नाम म्हणजे भगवंताचें नांव.
sentences.en: "Nama" means the Name of God.

sentences.mr: देवाच्या कोणत्याहि नांवांत फरक नाहीं.
sentences.en: There is no difference between any of God's names.

sentences.mr: नाम हा जीव आणि शिव यांमधील दुवा आहे.
sentences.en: The Name is the link between the individual soul (jiva) and God (Shiva).

sentences.mr: नाम हें साध्य आहे व साधनहि आहे.
sentences.en: The Name is both the goal and the means to it.

sentences.mr: नाम सगुण आहे आणि निर्गुणहि आहे.
sentences.en: The Name is saguna (God with form and attributes) and also nirguna (formless, attributeless).

sentences.mr: नामाचा आरंभ सगुणांत आहे व शेवट निर्गुणांत आहे.
sentences.en: The Name begins in the saguna and ends in the nirguna.

sentences.mr: आरंभ सगुणांत आहे असें म्हणण्याचें कारण हें कीं, भगवंत मुळांत जो निराकार, निर्गुण आहे, तो जेव्हां सगुणांत आला तेव्हांच त्याला नाम-रूप लागलें;
sentences.en: It is said to begin in the saguna because God, who is originally formless and without attributes, acquired name and form only when He assumed a manifest form;

sentences.mr: व सगुणरूप नाहींसें झालें तरी नाम शिल्लकच राहिलें, म्हणून तें निर्गुणहि आहे.
sentences.en: and even when that form dissolves, the Name remains — which is why it is nirguna as well.

sentences.mr: तेव्हां सगुण किंवा निर्गुण भक्तीला नामाचाच आधार आहे.
sentences.en: So whether devotion is to the formed or the formless, its support is the Name alone.

sentences.mr: नाम हा सत्संगाचा पाया आहे व कळसहि आहे.
sentences.en: The Name is both the foundation of satsang and its crowning pinnacle.

sentences.mr: नाम म्हणजे आपली वृत्ति आणि भगवंत यांना जोडणारी सांखळीच आहे.
sentences.en: The Name is the very chain that joins our inner disposition to God.

sentences.mr: लग्न झाल्यावर स्त्री जशी नवऱ्याशीं एकरूप होऊन जाते, त्याप्रमाणें वृत्तीचें नामाशीं लग्न होऊन ती नामरूप बनली पाहिजे.
sentences.en: Just as a wife becomes one with her husband after marriage, our disposition must be wedded to the Name until it takes the Name's own form.

sentences.mr: अन्नाला स्वतःची चव असते; त्याच्यामध्यें आपण आपली गोडी व आवड घालून नंतर तें आपण खातों.
sentences.en: Food has a taste of its own; we add our own relish and liking to it and then eat it.

sentences.mr: पण नामाला स्वतःची अशी चव नाहीं. त्याच्यामध्यें आपणच आपली गोडी घालून तें घेतलें पाहिजे.
sentences.en: But the Name has no such taste of its own. We ourselves must put our sweetness into it and then take it.

sentences.mr: आपण जितकी जास्त गोडी त्यामध्यें घालूं तितकें तें अधिक गोड वाटेल.
sentences.en: The more sweetness we pour into it, the sweeter it will taste.

sentences.mr: पंढरपूरला जाण्यास पुष्कळ रस्ते आहेत; परंतु सर्वांना शेवटीं “बारींतून” जाऊनच देवदर्शन घ्यावें लागतें.
sentences.en: There are many roads to Pandharpur; but in the end everyone must pass through the same narrow queue to have darshan of God.

sentences.mr: त्याप्रमाणें, इतर साधनें जरी केलीं तरी नामसाधन केल्यावरच आत्मस्वरूपाची प्राप्ति होते.
sentences.en: In the same way, whatever other practices one may follow, realisation of one's true Self comes only through the practice of the Name.

sentences.mr: आपण नाम घ्यावें, तें आपणच आपल्या कानांनीं ऐकावें, आणि तें घेतां घेतां त्यांत शेवटीं स्वतःला विसरून जावें, हाच नामसाधनेंतील आनंदाचा मार्ग आहे.
sentences.en: Take the Name, hear it with your own ears, and while taking it, at last forget yourself in it — this is the path of joy in the practice of the Name.

sentences.mr: जसें आपलें आपलेपण आपल्या नांवांत आहे, तसें देवाचें देवपण त्याच्या नामांत आहे.
sentences.en: Just as our own selfhood lives in our name, so God's godhood lives in His Name.

sentences.mr: आपण आज जें नाम घेतों तेंच नाम कायम राहतें; परंतु आपली देहबुद्धि जसजशी कमी होईल तसतसें तें नाम व्यापक व अर्थगर्भ बनत जातें, आणि शेवटीं नाम हें परमात्मस्वरूपच आहे असा अनुभव येतो.
sentences.en: The Name we take today stays the same; but as body-consciousness thins, that Name grows vaster and more laden with meaning, until at last one experiences that the Name is itself the Supreme Reality.

sentences.mr: पाणी हें जसें शरीराचें जीवन आहे, तसें नाम हें मनाचें “जीवन” बनलें पाहिजे.
sentences.en: As water is the life of the body, so must the Name become the “life” of the mind.

sentences.mr: अंतकाळीं अगदीं शेवटीं सुटणारी वस्तु म्हणजे भगवंताचें नाम पाहिजे. नामांत शेवटचा श्वास गेला पाहिजे.
sentences.en: At the end of life, the very last thing to leave us should be God's Name. The final breath should go out in the Name.

sentences.mr: नामांत एका आनंदाशिवाय दुसरें कांहीं नाहीं.
sentences.en: In the Name there is nothing but bliss.

footnote.mr: ज्याची प्रत्येक कृति रामाच्या स्मरणामध्यें होते तोच रामराज्यांत खरा राहतो.
footnote.en: He whose every act is done in remembrance of Rama is the one who truly dwells in Rama's kingdom.

summary_points.en: The Name is both the goal and the means — nothing further is needed beyond it.
The Name is the link between the soul and God; it is the chain that binds our disposition to Him.
The Name starts with form and ends in the formless — it outlives form itself, so it serves every kind of devotion.
The Name has no taste of its own; the sweetness you put in is the sweetness you get out.
Many roads, one final gate: other practices may help, but Self-realisation comes only through the Name.
The method in one line — say the Name, hear it yourself, and lose yourself in it.
Make the Name the life of the mind, as water is the life of the body.
Let the Name be the last thing to leave you — the final breath should go out in it.
